race.comment: AGADOO (4) has attracted solid market support at her past couple of outings without quite delivering, but she has shown enough ability, especially when finishing second fresh up, to suggest a win is not far away. If the track is wet, then her winning chances will soar. VEOMAS (3) resumes after a 5-month break and he will be a lot stronger now. He should go close to winning this race after a recent trial win, so follow any positive market moves. HARU (6) debuts for the powerful Tony Gollan stable and has created a positive impression at the trials, including a recent placing that suggests she has the ability to figure in the top 4. CERETTI (5) has never missed a placing when resuming, and she should be ready to perform well again. Include in all top 4 combos. MIMI'S (9) has been bought out of a leading Sydney stable, and she also returns from a spell after an encouraging trial win. With some luck from a wide gate, she won't be far away.
